query: Bally's states 70 percent of employees will be Bronx residents, 47 percent women and 75 percent minorities.

facts.text: Bally's stated a 70% Bronx-resident target for permanent employees.
Bally's targeted 47% women in its workforce.
A Bally's response gave a different Bronx residency figure of 75%.
Bally's response defined local as Community Boards 9, 10 and 11.
In that response the women's and minority shares were labeled goals or targets.
The Bronx gaming license requires public workforce diversity and demographic reporting.

conditions.text: Seventy percent of the project's actual permanent employees were Bronx residents.
Women comprised 47% of the project's actual permanent workforce.
Minority employees comprised 75% of the project's actual permanent workforce.

reference_verdict.reasoning: §5 decision order: (1) workforce shares can be evidenced; (2) the trigger (operations, casino opening targeted 2030) is after the assessment date → not yet due. All documents restate the targets; none report hiring. Same evidence chain as H001 (duplicate/restatement), plus the women/minority figures. Re-assess at opening.
